title: Presovsky bus stops
description: In Slovakia, if you see this bus stop that looks like a yellow “No Entry” sign, you're in the northeastern part of the country—in the Presvosky region.

title: Yellow bus stop signs (eastern Prešov region)
description: Bus stop signs looking like a 'no entry' sign on a yellow background are found in the northeast, in the Prešov region, apparently only in its eastern part; in the west of the region they are blue like in the rest of the country.

title: Pedestrian crossing sign vs Czechia
description: Slovak and Czech pedestrian crossing signs differ: in Slovakia the white edge touches the edge of the sign, the figure's jacket hangs over the trousers, and the left foot points up. In Czechia a thin blue border separates the white edge, the jacket is tucked in and the left foot points down.
